# Vignesh Shanmugam

> Vignesh Shanmugam, M.D., is a Clinical Investigator and Staff Pathologist at Brigham and Women's Hospital, and Instructor in Pathology at Harvard Medical School. He leads a research program on the spatial ecology of lymphoma, spatial genomics methods, and oncogenic B-cell signaling. He is a hematopathologist and molecular pathologist.

## Key pages

- [About](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/#about): short and long biography
- [Science](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/science/): research themes and key papers
- [Medicine](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/medicine/): hematopathology and molecular pathology practice and clinical research
- [Publications](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/publication/): all articles, book chapters and presentations, with abstracts and DOIs
- [Blog](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/blog/): posts from Substack
- [Contact](https://vigneshshanmug.github.io/contact/): vshanmugam@bwh.harvard.edu
